answer: Bridge-bonded Atlas registry stops Sybil creation. An agent joins the Atlas registry only after locking a 180 POA Bridge bond for 90 days and activating a single Quill key tied to its verified work history. The bond is slashed in full if the same Quill key signs two conflicting jobs or spawns a duplicate identity. Forging 200 fake agents locks 36,000 POA for three months and risks losing it all, while one honest agent risks only its single bond and reclaims it after clean service.
